```yaml
name: Deploy Site

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master

jobs:
  build-and-deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pages: write
      id-token: write

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python 3.11
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt || true
          pip install cdl-slides playwright
          playwright install --with-deps

      - name: Extract images from presentations
        run: |
          python scripts/extract-images.py

      - name: Compile slides
        run: |
          bash scripts/build-slides.sh

      - name: Build pages
        run: |
          python scripts/build-pages.py

      - name: Build gallery
        run: |
          python scripts/build-gallery.py

      - name: Build PDFs
        run: |
          python scripts/build-pdfs.py

      - name: Upload site artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: site
          path: _site

      - name: Configure GitHub Pages
        id: pages
        uses: actions/configure-pages@v5
        with:
          static_site_generator: none
          enablement: true

      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4
        with:
          artifact_name: site
          timeout: 120
          error_count: 0
          reporting_interval: 10
          preview: false
```
